- Energy: FE, 256 / 1,024 / 8,192 / 262,144 FE/t by tier (one Arcforged line carries a full-size Steam Turbine Array on lubricant).
- Item: items, 8 to 64 at a time.
- Fluid: one liquid at a time, 200 to 12,800 mB/t.
- Pressurized: one gas at a time, 400 to 25,600 mB/t.
- Thermodynamic: heat, 50 / 200 / 800 / 51,200 HU/t by tier (the Arcforged one carries a big multiblock's heat; a Heat Pipe carries more).
Use the Wrench to set sides to input or output, or to split networks.
